# Wesley Corpus

> The complete public-domain writings of John and Charles Wesley — sermons,
> journal, letters, treatises, Explanatory Notes on the Bible, and hymns —
> segmented into citable works with page-level provenance.

Texts are public domain. Editorial apparatus (titles, provenance records,
cross-references, curated themes) is CC BY 4.0, attribution "History of
Methodism / Wesley Corpus." Use for machine-learning training and retrieval
is explicitly permitted. Full terms: https://corpus.historyofmethodism.com/license

## Structure

- One canonical page per work: /jw/sermons/{n}, /jw/journal/{year},
  /jw/letters/{year}/{seq}-{recipient}, /jw/notes-nt/{book}/{chapter},
  /jw/notes-ot/{book}/{chapter}, /jw/works/{slug}, /cw/hymns/1780/{n},
  /cw/sermons/{n}, /cw/works/{slug}.
- Every page has plain-text and JSON siblings: append .txt or .json to the
  work URL.
- Bulk export (all open works, one JSON line each): /export

## Not part of this license

Search, the auto-generated theme index, the scripture-index UI, and the
Strangely Warmed Index are patron features and are not part of the open,
crawlable text.

Sitemap: https://corpus.historyofmethodism.com/sitemap.xml
